definitions.grammar_without_lesson: select g.id from grammar g where not exists(select 1 from lesson_items li where li.content_id=g.id)
definitions.example_without_vocabulary_grammar_or_pr: select e.id from examples e where not exists(select 1 from vocabulary_examples x where x.example_id=e.id) and not exists(select 1 from grammar_examples x where x.example_id=e.id) and not exists(select 1 from pronunciation_examples x where x.example_id=e.id)
definitions.vocabulary_without_meaning: select v.id from vocabulary v where not exists(select 1 from meanings m where m.vocabulary_id=v.id)
definitions.course_without_lesson: select c.id from courses c where not exists(select 1 from lessons l where l.course_id=c.id)
definitions.question_without_target_lesson_audio_or_: select q.id from questions q where q.listening_id is null and not exists(select 1 from content_links l where l.source_id=q.id and l.relation='question_target') and not exists(select 1 from lesson_items li where li.content_id=q.id) and not exists(select 1 from audio_questions a where a.question_id=q.id)

ownership_note: Listening questions are owned through questions.listening_id FK; ignoring it flags1849 legitimate existing rows. No such content rows were deleted/retargeted.
